title: Re-encoded audio that loses channels says so, and the default for a profile that names none follows Jellyfin 12.4
description: A 5.1 track re-encoded for a profile with no MaxAudioChannels arrives as stereo with no reason given (#295).
notes: Dropped (D-126 and the pivot, D-107): Merged into JS-185: a playback that loses channels says so. The 'default follows Jellyfin' half is dropped (rule 3).
acceptanceCriteria: Observed first: what Jellyfin 12.4 sends for a surround track, and what reasons it gives, when the HLS transcoding profile has no MaxAudioChannels.

Whenever the output has fewer channels than the source, re-encoded or refused a copy, TranscodeReasons includes AudioChannelsNotSupported, whether the limit came from the profile or from the default. If Jellyfin does not, the difference is listed in compat/differences.yaml.
The default number of channels is the observed one, and it applies to the copy test (invariant 52) and to the encode alike.
